question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab8f07036864d224ec5e5aec30eda2f8d6f527a08deff40a64436100c6215f2b.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: **The alternate image is the result of interchange the top and bottom symbols of previous image in triangle shape**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5bfd4f25a60c3afb1c5ccbdb375ed809e63f97ce91d34c7963f5557e0729faf.png] **

Step II: **The alternate image is getting interchanged its symbol as shown below:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04db5a7a551bff401978f0f322cbeb86289afdf3ae365eaed956a7d01502b28c.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4216163e4ec61f970477cddbde14eaaf8e7db1690087b59b4c5f12d787f6f15e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
